svg.aria-label: adam siwiec. Seasoned Solution Architect. Software Engineer. Data & AI Expert. Entrepreneur. I implement full-stack, data-driven, artificial intelligence and machine learning enhanced software solutions customized to the unique needs of niche, rapidly growing businesses. I contribute to open source and mentor engineers in software engineering, AI/ML, and offensive security. My team and I create real business value every day. FreeTech, Devrecated, OpenHat. Rust, Go, TypeScript, Python, TensorFlow, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Linux.
